name: native-select
title: Native select
description: The platform's own select in a Keyline field frame: the caret cell drawn over its end, the OS list in the page's scheme, options or groups, a Field participant (name, required, validate, Form errors).
whenToUse: Use it in long forms on phones and for fields the browser can autofill; the open list is the system's. For a styled list that docks to its field use Select.

parts.name: NativeSelect
parts.description: NativeSelect: the platform's own <select> in a Keyline field frame. For long forms on touch devices, autofill (country, region), and anywhere the OS picker is the better list; Select is the styled listbox for everything else. A Field participant (name, required, validate, Form errors). The open list is the operating system's: it follows the page's light or dark scheme, not the theme. Single choice only: a multiple select is a CheckboxGroup or Multiselect here.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own frame. cell: a cell of an enclosing frame (label visually hidden).

props.name: options
props.description: Options (or labelled groups of options). Or pass <option>/<optgroup> children instead.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An empty first option. Not selectable again once a value is chosen when `required`.
